mapper.insert:
insert into approval_info ( leave_id, approval_people_id, approval_status, crt_id, crt_time ) values
(#{item.leaveId}, #{item.approvalPeopleId}, #{item.approvalStatus}, #{item.crtId}, #{item.crtTime})
mapper.select: select ap.user_id,MIN(als.approval_priority) from approval_info ai LEFT JOIN approval_people ap on ai.approval_people_id = ap.id LEFT JOIN approval_level_set als on ap.approval_level_id = als.id where ai.leave_id = #{id}
